diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index e367ed0bd9..2c63a950af 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -274,10 +274,6 @@ jobs:
       - name: Type Check
         run: pnpm --filter frontend type-check
 
-      # Mirrors the lefthook pre-push step so a skipped local hook cannot bypass it.
-      - name: Canonical boundary check
-        run: pnpm check:canonical
-
       - name: Test Shared with Coverage
         run: pnpm --filter "@monalee-engineering/shared" test:coverage
 
@@ -703,12 +699,6 @@ jobs:
       - name: Install dependencies
         run: pnpm install --filter backend... --frozen-lockfile
 
-      # The frontend job runs the same check, but its paths filter excludes
-      # packages/backend, so a backend-only PR would skip it — and one of the two
-      # scanned trees is packages/backend/api/logic.
-      - name: Canonical boundary check
-        run: pnpm check:canonical
-
       - name: Biome Check
         run: pnpm --filter backend check
 
diff --git a/packages/frontend/scripts/canonical/canonical-rules.ts b/packages/frontend/scripts/canonical/canonical-rules.ts
index 7e98b2f48f..10f3876e7f 100644
--- a/packages/frontend/scripts/canonical/canonical-rules.ts
+++ b/packages/frontend/scripts/canonical/canonical-rules.ts
@@ -47,29 +47,4 @@ export const CANONICAL_RULES: readonly CanonicalRule[] = [
     why: 'One implementation per algorithm, so a fix in one copy cannot silently miss the other.',
     owner: 'Web-dev',
   },
-  {
-    // Reject matching raw listeners unless their source file is inside one of the approved engine paths below.
-    kind: 'only-inside',
-    // Stable name shown in diagnostics and rule statistics.
-    id: 'keyboard-listener',
-    // Recursively scan production source files in the 3D editor feature.
-    scope: 'packages/frontend/src/features/3d-viz-v2',
-    // Match addEventListener calls made on the browser window, document, or scene canvas.
-    receivers: ['window', 'document', 'canvas'],
-    // Keep the ticket's explicit input-receiver no-fire case while catching every other element alias.
-    ignoredReceivers: ['input'],
-    // Match all three browser keyboard event names.
-    channels: ['keydown', 'keyup', 'keypress'],
-    // Raw scene keyboard listeners are permitted only at these engine-owned boundaries.
-    allowedInside: [
-      'packages/frontend/src/features/3d-viz-v2/api/engine',
-      'packages/frontend/src/features/3d-viz-v2/api/active-scene-drag.ts',
-    ],
-    // Route every other scene keyboard listener through this adapter and its real argument order.
-    replacement: 'useSceneElementEventListener(target, type, listener, opts)',
-    why: 'The engine owns scene keyboard gating and listener teardown, so feature listeners must use its adapter.',
-    owner: 'Web development team',
-    // Temporary file exceptions belong here with a reason, accountable owner, and short expiry date.
-    allowlist: {},
-  },
 ];
